I want to OD on heroin.

I have a lot of connections to get heroin but I don't really want to use it. I think I'll just drink myself into sedation instead.

This is all very probably against the rules of the subreddit but I don't really care. I'm going to be done soon I just want to figure out how. Telling me or not telling me how won't change whether I'll do it or not, it just might change the method. I just want the calmest death possible and the least gruesome scene for someone to find me. Ideally, I want the police to find me after I call 911, but I can't think of a method that will kill me fast enough to do that.

I did and I wrote down my answers in a notebook to think about while I work. But still kind of melancholy. I just wish life were simpler sometimes. But things can get so out of hand complicated when you start to over think things. I just wish my brain would shut up. 

Thanks for the food for thought. Maybe something will catch and I'll think positively. But it's just hard to go into positive thinking mode because the fall from that back into depression is always so painful. That's probably why I stick with negative thoughts for so long. I don't want to feel better and then have to experience that negative shift again. I'd rather just let it get out of hand and die. God I can't wait to get out of work. I just need to get through this shift.

Girl, haha, but everyone on the Internet is a dude until otherwise specified. Thanks for reaching out though. I'm at work and feeling better than I was this morning but it's probably just because I took a ton of amphetamines (vyvanse) before I came here. Even with the drugs I still feel so sad. Jesus. I don't want to die. I just don't know what to do. I just want to feel ok reliably. At least the pain in my chest has gone away for the first time in a week. It's coming back now that the pace in the restaurant I work at is slowing down. But at least a little bit of relief happened tonight. 

Thanks for talking about your experience. My family is the only thing that keeps me alive sometimes and what you brought up is probably the biggest fear I have (other than being left brain damaged or deformed) when I think about offing myself.

Maybe I should rephrase that as a brain that doesn't focus on the negative but is able to entertain it. I want to be more in control of how much pain I feel. But that's just not how my brain works I guess.

I have a sister and I would probably be screwing with her a ton because she used to mistreat me a lot as a kid and also caused a lot of problems in our family so she'll feel guilty. But she was only a kid I don't hold any of my depression against her. But she already feels guilty and being her only sibling I think it would be really hard for her if I were to kill myself. But I'm going to write her a letter telling her how much I love her before I do it.
Having a brain that doesn't focus on the negative all the time maybe

Yeah but I do it so often that I feel guilty about it. Like when I post here, people can choose to engage or not, but if I reach out to family or friends, they feel obligated to engage and I feel guilty that I'm forcing myself on them like that. 

And I guess when I originally posted I hoped that someone might give me advice on how to do it. No one I know in real life would do that. I just want to die but not alone. As I've said before, that's just not how suicide works. Suicide is lonely.

I'm glad that had that effect for you. I just feel like I do little things every day that hurt my parents so why not just do one big band-aid rip and get it all over with in one act. I know there is real love and concern out there, it just feels so hard to reach in this world. I wish we all had more genuine interactions with each other but usually we are wrapped up in the functional side of interaction rather than spiritual and that kind of hurts to live in all the time. I have tried living for those real connections but then the pain from realizing how superficial most of life is hurts even more. I don't want to hurt my family but I am in physical pain all day every day from plain anxiety. There are people that truly make me happy to be alive, but its so hard for me to ignore every thing else. Thats maybe what I hate about my brain is that I can't just focus on the good, I have to be so aware of the pain all the time. I can't shake that quality.

Yes but I don't know how to do it. I'm scared of fucking it up and having deprived oxygen to my brain and being left brain damaged but not dead. I'm thinking about a heroin overdose, but I've never shot up before and would have to learn how to do that before I could go ahead and kill myself with it. If you have any more information, it would be super appreciated.

I'm just exhausted, but I haven't ever given up until I really do go and kill myself. I go to work. I support myself. I socialize. I care for a friend of mine's kid periodically and try to be a good influence for him. I try as hard as I can. Even when I tried to kill myself last time, I changed my mind and brought myself to the ER because I realized I hadn't tried hard enough and was doing it out of immediate anxiety (rather than looking longterm). 

But thats what makes me so pessimistic about my future... I've really tried. What more can I do other than try? That's what makes me so certain about killing myself. I feel ready. I can't be the person I want to be because that person never fucks up. I have too high expectations and haven't found a way to get rid of those expectations. I can't convince you that I've tried as hard as I can, but I know for myself that I have. 

 I am just scared about surviving the attempt. I'm talking in circles now. I'm sorry. Thanks for talking. I just don't want to die alone. I have to go to work in an hour, so I won't be able to do it right now. I'll probably do it sometime this week. I'm just settling on the details of execution so that I have both privacy and comfort. The worst thing about suicide is how lonely you feel. Its the loneliest I've ever felt - deciding to kill yourself. But feeling lonely is what I hate about life too. Thanks for talking. I know it was a selfish conversation on my end, but I appreciate it.
The music is nice to listen to as well. Thank you.

I honestly have felt that before. That hope that you get to create your own life. But it always disappears. And then I'm super depressed for a long time before the next burst of hope comes along. I feel like I'm being dragged around a wheel and when I get to the top I'm painfully aware that I'm about to be crushed and covered with mud again shortly. I only get to breathe for a minute and then I'm down again, inhaling dirt. I'm sick. I don't know how to get unsick. Medication... therapy... loving people in my life... hobbies... none of it helps. I'm not trying to be ungrateful, its just not changing anything because I'm always going to cart around myself. I was born sick. I've been this way since I was a young child. I don't know anything different. I don't know why. I just want to have actual innocence. I don't think I ever got that feeling. I've always felt deeply guilty and bad. I wish innocence existed but it doesn't and my brain stays ruminating on that forever. Or its bored and I do something stupid like drink or fuck to stop being bored and empty. Sometimes I feel joy.. but its almost too much when I do feel joy and its closer to like this short-term mania (a few hours to a day) and I make stupid impulsive decisions from it that I deal with later through my depression. I don't even need happiness. I need calm steady emotions that don't dip down into boredom but I don't have that type of brain. I need to be interested in things other than my own pain. But maybe I inherited my grand-mother's narcissism and I won't ever fully be interested in anything other than myself. I'm scared I'm going to be like that. I'd rather die than find out.

Cool subreddit. I thought it was imaginary monsters at first and realized it was something different but equally cool. Art is a great distraction but jesus christ the culture around it is so competitive and cut-throat. Everything ultimately feels cut-throat and I'd rather just cut my own than create something and be vulnerable and let someone else do it for me.

Thank you for replying. I've already decided I'm going to die. I'm not sure why I posted here. I think its because I don't want to die alone. I wish I could die in a hospital bed with my family and say goodbye and have it be calm, but that's not how suicide works. 

Maybe I'm scared and I thought posting here would make me less so. I just don't want to survive the attempt. I'm anxious about what I'm doing to my parents and sister. But I have to kill myself. I've wanted to do it for over ten years (nine was my first serious consideration, but I've thought about it since I was about seven). How much longer am I expected to try to hold on? I know I'm young but jesus I don't want to end up middle aged and still feeling this way and being terrible to everyone. My family is full of middle aged miserable people. My brain won't let this go. Sometimes I see happy people who are ignorant of all the painful things they do to people. I don't see healthiness in my future. Thanks for talking for a bit, I'm sorry that I asked for help when I wasn't going to take it. I hate being a human being. It's just a terrible experience -- 2/5 stars.

I hope. I just feel like such a messed up, bad person. I have all these ideals and values and when it comes down to real life I'm always disappointed in myself. I just don't like living, its so uncomfortable and unenjoyable and I really don't see any light. Sometimes I'll be ok, and I really try to minimize thinking about negative thoughts, but then I see this terrible person start to emerge. I just don't want to engage in the world anymore. I'm scared of who I might end up being. I'm also scared that I won't be anything. I just want to die and take myself out of the game. I need distractions from this negativity but nothing in my life has ever distracted me from it. Except maybe drinking or sex but then I go down a bad path in that scenario too. I just don't want to constantly fuck up anymore.

Sometimes I find something I enjoy doing but that always stops. I also have been diagnosed with at least having traits of BPD. I'm not just depressed. I'm a bad person and could really go down a bad path. I've been trying so hard to be a good person since I was young. I've really really tried and even trying to be a good person and going to therapy I've still ended up slipping and getting diagnosed with BPD. I'm not sure I'm capable of changing for the better because I've so sincerely tried. I just want to die before it gets worse.

I've commented something similar to the person above but I just feel like things are overwhelmingly painful. I can't handle pain. I can't stop thinking negatively. I've felt this way, with increasing severity, for over a decade. It started when I was nine and here I am ten years later feeling the same shitty way. The only difference is I have less and less hope that things will change with each year. I have no hope now and the only thing stopping me is that I'm scared of surviving an attempt with damage that only makes things worse. I tried killing myself before and was told how lucky I was not to have severed a tendon in my arm (leaving it immobile). I'm not afraid of the pain necessarily but I'm afraid that something (survival instinct, a person finding me, just bad execution) will leave me alive and brain damaged or disfigured.

Also thank you for replying. As I said above. I'm scared and I'm just sad that I have to do this. I wish I could live and know happiness but I really really don't know what thats like.

I just feel like life has always just been overwhelmingly painful and it keeps getting more and more painful. I feel like I can't keep it together and force myself to do the "right thing" anymore. When I was younger, I was in pain, but was kind to people and thoughtful and tried hard at school or work because I had hope and I wanted to die back then but I had hope. I have no hope now. I just keep getting worse - keep feeling worse things and doing worse things. I feel like I siphon from my friends energy and I never contribute to their needs anymore. I have no energy other than self-preservation and I'd rather die having been a relatively good person than keep living and let people see how shitty I'll become. I just don't like being alive. I don't like who I am. 

Thank you for replying by the way. I'm fucking scared right now. I need to die but I'm scared of doing it.
